properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js provides the SHA-1/224/256/384/512 and RIPEMD-160 used inside ethers' hashing/ABI helpers. The build ships these algorithms whether or not the app calls them directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency: tweetnacl@0.14.5 ships the Ed25519 signature primitive in the deployed build. Not declared directly in package.json (transitive, resolved via yarn.lock); no first-party Ed25519 call site found by grep of *.js — the asset is the shipped capability. Changeable here by upgrading/pruning the dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Not merely shipped — this is the quantum-vulnerable signature primitive actually wired into first-party code: secp256k1 ECDSA signs ForkDelta orders (ethUtil.ecsign, exchanges/Forkdelta.js:571) and raw Ethereum transactions (ethereumjs-tx tx.sign, :423-424), both filed as findings. Migration is constrained by the Ethereum/EVM protocol (secp256k1 is mandatory on-chain), so replacement is only possible at the protocol level.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency: elliptic@6.3.3 provides ECDH/ECDSA over secp256k1 and is the engine behind the first-party Ethereum signing code (ethUtil.ecsign in exchanges/Forkdelta.js reaches secp256k1/elliptic). Transitive dep of the ethereumjs stack; its ECDH surface has no standalone first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency: tweetnacl@0.14.5 ships X25519 key agreement in the deployed build. Transitive (not in package.json dependencies); no first-party X25519 call site found — the asset is the shipped capability, quantum-vulnerable class B-.
